content: Playwright webServer config (playwright.dev/docs/test-webserver fetched 2026-09-10): url-based readiness polling accepts 2xx/3xx and 400/401/402/403 responses; reuseExistingServer:!process.env.CI reuses an already-running server locally; timeout default 60000ms; env inherits process.env plus PLAYWRIGHT_TEST=1 (override with webServer.env — set CRON_MODE=vercel and test DATABASE_URL there); baseURL lives under use; multiple servers via array (all must be ready); gracefulShutdown sends SIGTERM/SIGINT then kill — SIGTERM/SIGINT not supported on Windows (kill fallback; dev machine is Windows).
